title: The Brownian bubble tea
summary: We use Loewner-Kufarev evolution to decompose the Brownian loop soup into a Poisson point process on Brownian bubbles which we call the Brownian bubble tea driven by $ρ$, where $ρ$ is the driving measure for the Loewner chain. The only assumption on $ρ$ is that the evolving boundaries are locally connected. This generalizes a similar disintegration result of Lawler and Werner to essentially optimal regularity, and includes foliations with finite Loewner-Kufarev energy as well as radial and whole-plane $\mathrm{SLE}_κ$ for all $κ\geqslant 0$.
